bin_time_basis: actual user-side return time at A
right_panel_time_basis: Scheduled-arrival cohorts; every offer in each five-second bin
right_panel_envelope: Minimum to maximum over all three run-level fractions, not a confidence interval
return_definition: Correct ID-matched result received at Edge1 within 500 ms of planned arrival; late returns excluded.
variability: Displayed curves are descriptive run means; CSV retains all 3 run series.
event_time_basis: Elapsed seconds from the first scheduled arrival (t=0); not request processing duration.
figure_caption: End-device domain autonomy under loss of cloud connectivity. Only Edge1 initially hosts an application executor; Edge2 is an idle compatible device in the same domain. The cloud control node is unreachable during 20-110 s while Edge1-Edge2 connectivity is retained. (a) shows correct responses received at Edge1 within 500 ms per non-overlapping 5-s return-time bin, averaged over three runs; dashed gray shows offered arrivals. Tide shading separates execution on Edge1 and Edge2, verified from physical-host journals. (b) shows the mean fraction of all scheduled arrivals in each 5-s cohort returning correctly within 500 ms, with min-max envelopes over three runs; failures remain in the denominator. Tide first returns a timely result via Edge2 at elapsed t=47.6 s on average, measured from the first scheduled arrival, during the cloud interruption. This supports domain-local service and executor activation under the tested control placement; it does not establish a change in the structural capability metric R_cap.
